build_postprocessors: build the default postprocessors registry for a Markdown instance with raw HTML and ampersand substitution
run_raw_html_postprocessor: run the RawHtmlPostprocessor to restore stashed raw HTML blocks back into the serialized document text
run_amp_substitute_postprocessor: run the AndSubstitutePostprocessor to replace internal ampersand substitutes with actual ampersand characters in output text
check_blocklevel_html: check if a given HTML string is block-level using the RawHtmlPostprocessor isblocklevel method
run_unescape_postprocessor: run the deprecated UnescapePostprocessor to restore escaped characters marked with STX and ETX control codes
